native_binaries.source/build/justfit-engine: C++/Objective-C++ engine built from source/runtime with the Xcode toolchain
native_binaries.source/build/justfit-rs: Rust frontend (bin/justfit) built from rust/frontend, source paths remapped
native_binaries.source/build/JustFitVision.app: Rust ANE vision worker built from rust/ane-worker, source paths remapped

signing: The JustFit native binaries and libraries are signed with Developer ID Application team 68M2VQ7A96 and a secure timestamp; they are not notarized. PDFium keeps its upstream ad-hoc signature.
hashes: runtime/runtime.zip carries runtime.json with the SHA-256 of every native output; package-manifest.json pins every packaged file.
